entries.title: The form says what the letters do
entries.summary: Under the 2027 sign-up form, "No list, no marketing" became "I'll write a few times before April, and you can tell me to stop," so the page matches the save the date, which promises notes in December, January and February.

entries.title: The month stays whole
entries.summary: On a phone the line above the wordmark broke after the hyphen, reading MID- on one line and APRIL on the next.

entries.title: Photos on 2026, voices on 2025
entries.summary: Seven photos from the 2026 walk sit under each day, the Marina dunes running wider than the text. The 2025 page gains a chorus: three walkers answering a question on camera, verbatim, named.

entries.title: The family's focus ring
entries.summary: Keyboard focus draws a 2px pen ring on every link, button and field, the invite form included. Links stay sienna, the walk's one treatment; the Elsewhere tiles hover in pen.

entries.title: Newsreader replaces Fraunces
entries.summary: Fraunces is gone (JC: “I don’t like this font”). Newsreader, a text serif with optical sizes, now sets every page, in the walk’s register: warm, story-first, a letter from a friend.
